calculation.expression: cross_sectional_reversal(return_3d) conditioned and scaled by downside shock intensity
calculation.description: Contrarian cross-asset signal that emphasizes instruments experiencing unusually large downside moves, using only completed daily prices and a cross-sectional downside-shock condition.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in 2020-2022 (0.053826), 2023-2024 (0.025321), and 2025-2027 (0.035466); 15-asset cross-section requires conservative interpretation.
